subject: GaiaHealth privacy intake: DPA/SCC preference + SOC 2 snapshot
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@gaiahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GaiaHealth privacy intake: DPA/SCC preference + SOC 2 snapshot

Hi Aisha —

Great to meet the team this morning. Quick recap from my side and the asks we discussed so procurement/legal can triage: 

- Summary: GaiaHealth will be sending sample patient data to Redwood for inference in the pilot (de-identified for now). You indicated privacy and auditability are top priorities.
- Controller/Processor: please confirm if GaiaHealth expects Redwood to be a data processor (our read is yes, but want explicit confirmation).
- DPA & SCC: do you have a preferred DPA form or SCC module (Module 1 minimal vs Module 2 full + transfers)? If you already have a legal template, please attach.
- SOC 2/HIPAA: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA posture notes — could you confirm which artifacts procurement needs and the timing?

Action items we discussed: 
1) Gaia to share DPA preference and any required redlines (procurement/legal).
2) Gaia to return the vendor security questionnaire (attached blank copy for convenience).
3) Redwood to share DPA template and latest SOC 2 report.

I attached the vendor security questionnaire we typically ask customers to fill (one tab per control area). If it's easier I can have our security ops run a short intake call to go through items flagged as high priority (PII handling, retention, audit access).

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (blank)

Next step: could you confirm by EOD whether you want us to sign as Processor and whether Gaia prefers SCC Module 2 (full) or Module 1 (baseline)? If you prefer, we can draft the mutual action plan and route DPA for redlines.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales (West)
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-1212

From: Aisha Morgan <aisha.morgan@gaiahealth.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GaiaHealth privacy intake: DPA/SCC preference + SOC 2 snapshot

Neha —

Thanks for the recap and for the questionnaire. Confirming the following from our side after today's call: 

- Controller/Processor: GaiaHealth will be the Controller; we expect Redwood to act as a Processor.
- SCC preference: our legal team prefers Module 2 (full processor protections + transfer clauses). We're open to Module 1 only if Redwood proposes compensating controls and a clear transfer mechanism.
- SOC 2 / HIPAA: we require a current SOC 2 Type II report and evidence of HIPAA alignment (BAA conversation). Please share your latest SOC 2 and a short HIPAA posture statement.
- Procurement timeline: we are aiming to finish contracting within 3 weeks if redlines are limited. We may need a DocuSign route once redlines are agreed.

Attached: GAIA_DPA_Request_Form.docx (our DPA checklist), Vendor_Sec_Q_Gaia_Filled.xlsx (initial answers from security)

We will route any legal redlines to the email above (procurement@gaiahealth.com). If Redwood can share your DPA template and SOC 2 now, that would accelerate review.

Best,
Aisha Morgan
Head of Vendor Risk
Gaia Health

Hi Aisha / Neha —

Thanks for the clear notes, Aisha. A few clarifications from Redwood legal/contracting: 

- Controller/Processor: good — Redwood will accept Processor role for this engagement. We'll lock that in the DPA.
- SCC module: Module 2 is acceptable. For clarity, when you say Module 2, can you confirm you mean the EU SCCs with Processor Addendum (i.e., full processor clauses + transfer mechanisms)? If Gaia has a local variant or additional transfer modules, please flag.
- SOC 2 / HIPAA: attaching our standard artifacts here: Redwood_DPA_Template_v3.pdf (our go-to DPA) and Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (latest full report redacted). If you need an unredacted SOC 2 under an NDA, we can provide it to procurement/legal. We can also add language for a BAA if Gaia requires HIPAA-covered processing.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Gaia to mark preferred SCC module explicitly in the attached GAIA_DPA_Request_Form (procurement).
2) Redwood to take any marked redlines and produce a redline back within 3 business days.
3) If SOC 2 full copy required, sign the mutual NDA -> we provide.

Cc'ing Laura (legal) to confirm retention/audit request language we typically see.

Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GaiaHealth privacy intake: DPA/SCC preference + SOC 2 snapshot

Aisha —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple quick legal notes after reviewing your GAIA_DPA_Request_Form and Vendor_Sec_Q_Gaia_Filled.xlsx: 

- Retention: please confirm the retention period for pilot data. Our standard DPA limits retention to the duration of the service plus 90 days for troubleshooting unless otherwise agreed. If Gaia needs longer retention for clinical review, we can scope that as an exception.
- Audit rights: we accept remote audit with reasonable notice; onsite audits need to be scoped. If you require SOC 2 evidence sharing more frequently, let's specify cadence in the Exhibit.
- Transfers: if Module 2 is selected, we'll include the Processor Addendum and the relevant SCCs. Please call out any specific sub-processors or cloud regions that must be excluded.

I've drafted a short mutual action plan to keep things moving: 
- Day 0 (today): Gaia returns GAIA_DPA_Request_Form with SCC module marked + any redlines (procurement).
- Day 1-3: Redwood produces a redline to your DPA (contracts).
- Day 4-7: Procurement/legal review & confirm final route; SOC 2 unredacted provided under NDA if requested.
- Day 8-14: DocuSign routing and signature.

DocuSign routing placeholder: https://docusign.example.com/exec/abc123

If that timeline works, Jordan or Neha, please confirm and we'll start the contract redline. Aisha, happy to hop on a 30-minute call with procurement if that helps speed the review.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference
